name: termetrix
description: Minimal VS Code productivity extension for project awareness

termetrix.scan.maxDurationSeconds.description: Maximum scan duration in seconds (partial results are shown if the limit is reached)

termetrix.scan.autoScanMode.description: Controls when Termetrix automatically runs scans (startup and/or root changes)

termetrix.scan.maxDirectories.description: Maximum number of directories to scan (partial results are shown if the limit is reached)

termetrix.statusBar.showTerminalButton.description: Show the one-click terminal button in the status bar

termetrix.statusBar.showSelectionLineCou.description: Show the selected lines counter in the status bar

termetrix.logging.verbose.description: Enable verbose logging for performance metrics and debugging (logs to 'Termetrix' output channel)

termetrix.panel.autoScanLoc.description: Automatically run LOC scan when the Termetrix panel opens

scripts.vscode:prepublish: pnpm run build:prod && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint
scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out', { recursive: true, force: true })" && node esbuild.mjs
scripts.build:prod: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out', { recursive: true, force: true })" && node esbuild.mjs --production
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit
